Overview

Trbovlje is a city in Trbovlje with a population of 14,000. A town in the Zasavje region, known for its mining heritage, the iconic Trbovlje Power Plant chimney (one of Europe’s tallest), and a strong community spirit. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
